signatures.description: Given a batch of ECDSA signatures over secp256k1 whose nonces each leak their top bits (hidden number problem), recover the private key by constructing the lattice of nonce equations and reducing it with an in-process LLL implementation, without any native crypto libraries beyond Node's BigInt. Requirements: derive the lattice basis from per-signature bounds, implement LLL with exact rational Gram-Schmidt coefficients to avoid floating-point drift, extract candidate keys from reduced rows, and validate each candidate by re-deriving signatures before reporting. Tests include underdetermined samples that must report insufficient-leakage rather than emit a wrong key.
